title: Fix a flash-attention kernel that mis-merges block statistics (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
8 queries, D=4, 16 keys processed as 2 blocks of 8, one thread per query row.
The second K-block is deliberately larger in magnitude than the first, so the running max genuinely changes on that merge (alpha != 1), exposing a missing-rescale bug.
